mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained increase in GDPC1 (demand) over 3 months predicts rising equity valuations and positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not rise or 20-day returns are negative despite the trend.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained rise in INDPRO (supply index) over 3 months reduces inflationary pressures, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise or returns are negative in 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: Decreasing UNRATE (improving labor market) over 3 months signals strong job market, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE doesn't decline or returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS crossing above 2.5% triggers negative 20-day returns as investors anticipate higher rates.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS doesn't cross 2.5% or returns are positive despite.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (demand) and falling UNRATE (labor) signals expansion, leading to positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The combination doesn't occur or returns are negative despite.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) with FEDFUNDS below 2% signals overheating, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, returns not positive despite inflation and low rates.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicates robust activity, leading to positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: The combination doesn't occur or returns are negative in 5 days.
